name: obix-compiler-diagnostics
description: The frontend-neutral diagnostic contract of the OBIX compiler family: ObixCompilerDiagnostic, source positions and ranges, diagnostic spaces, upstream metadata and the common compile-stage status and result types, with the checks that say whether a value honours them. It depends on nothing: no Vue, no React, no DOM, no runtime. Phase 4 of the VueTS compiler recovery (docs/recovery/vuets-compiler.md).
author: Nnamdi Michael Okpala <okpalan@protonmail.com>
